intent.instructions: Classify the primary intent of the user request described in the state.

criteria.bug_fix: Fixing broken or incorrect existing behavior: error, crash, wrong output, regression.
criteria.new_feature: Adding new functionality or capability that does not exist yet.
criteria.question: Asking for information, explanation, review, or clarification; no code change requested.
criteria.refactor: Restructuring existing code without changing behavior: rename, reorganize, cleanup.
criteria.docs_config: Documentation-only or configuration/infra edits that change no product behavior: README, changelog, docs, CI workflow, dependency bumps, formatting, git maintenance.
criteria.other: None of the listed categories fit (e.g. docs-only, infra config, version-control ops, brainstorming).
